title: Field fibre homology preservation
statement: theorem single_field_fibre_homology {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d) (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))) (i r : ℕ) (hzero : ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero (P.homology q)) (hrank : (P.homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r) {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (hR : IsField R) (f : Spec R ⟶ Y) : let Q := ((Modules.pullback f).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P (∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero (Q.homology q)) ∧ (Q.homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r

proof.text: Finite locally free sheaves are flat: apply finiteLocallyFree_tensorLeft_exact and use the tensor braiding to obtain exactness of tensorRight. The finite free terms of P are therefore flat. The bound hle gives bounded-above support.

Apply flatComplexDerivedPullback to P. Its object and map equalities identify the termwise functor with tensorPullback by CategoryTheory.Functor.ext. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensorPullback with Modules.pullback, using nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction. The quotient and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors isomorphisms give Q(f*P) isomorphic to Lf*(Q(P)).

Nonnegative support makes negative homology zero. Together with hzero this makes Q(P) concentrated in integer degree i. Mathlib DerivedCategory.isGE_iff, isLE_iff and exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE give Q(P) isomorphic to a single object M in degree i. Applying homologyFunctorFactors and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso identifies M with H^i(P), so M is finite locally free of rank r and flat.

The single complex on the flat sheaf M is bounded above by i; its term at i is M and all other terms are zero and flat. The zero-flat argument uses the monoidal preadditive structure supplied by tensorClosed and ObjectProperty.flat_of_isZero. Apply the same termwise derived-pullback comparison and HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex to identify Lf*(M[-i]) with (f*M)[-i]. Compose with the isomorphisms of the preceding steps.

Apply each homology functor to the resulting isomorphism. Homology of a single complex vanishes away from i and equals f*M at i (Mathlib isZero_single_obj_homology and singleObjHomologySelfIso). The already proved library instance AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.LocallyFreeRank preserves rank r. Transport both assertions along the homology isomorphisms. No flatness of the map to the field is used, and rank zero, i outside the support, and the empty scheme are included.
